lc_person: Cyrus John MacMillan, McGill English professor, author and politician (died 1953); author of McGill and its story (1921).
item_person: Cyrus Macmillan, McGill academic, writer and politician; Wikidata gives 1882–1953.

evidence.says: Current heading gives 1878–1953 and cites McGill and its story. A 2022 publisher communication supports 1878 from reported registration and baptism records; the same authority also records LAC's 1882 heading and matching McGill career.
Identifies Cyrus Macmillan as academic, writer and politician, with McGill as employer, birth year 1882, death year 1953, and P244 nr97007678.
UPEI's Robertson Library biography gives 1877, attributing that year to PEI Public Archives birth and baptism records, while explicitly documenting competing years 1881, 1882 and 1883.
McGill's finding aid identifies the English professor, author and politician through the same academic career and works, but its access point gives 1883–1953.

notes: Identity is secure; capitalization is immaterial. Birth year remains unresolved: LC's 1878 and UPEI's 1877 both invoke archival records, while other institutional records give 1882 or 1883. The underlying birth records were not inspected.
